name: card
useFor: Use default for a small fact block in a grid (Trigger, Delivery, Response contract): a glyph-led 14px title and a muted description. Use raised for a white panel that sits on lilac or holds rows. Use muted for a grouped setting inside a dialog (a channel with its toggle in CardAction). Put a button or toggle in CardAction at the top right.
constraints: Nesting cards more than one level
source: Figma 427:2715: Webhooks - Event catalog (Trigger, Delivery, Response contract), Create Agent Identity (Email, Phone Number channel cards)
